items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund that scales with valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic承諾將5%股份投入新公益基金，隨估值成長而增加
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced on October 18 that it will commit 5% of its shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a wholly-owned LLC, subject to stockholder approval. An additional 2% can be added at board discretion for every 50% increase in company value above a set baseline; combined with founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of shares would be dedicated to public benefit.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於10月18日宣布，將在股東批准下把5%股份投入全新的Anthropic公益基金（全資LLC）。公司價值每較基線增加50%，董事會可再酌增2%；加上創辦人與員工承諾，約20%股份將用於公益。
items_flat.analysis_en: This structure directly ties Anthropic’s commercial growth to expanding public-benefit resources as a public benefit corporation, distinguishing it from typical tech equity practices. Key details on governance, baseline valuation, and actual deployment remain to be disclosed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此結構直接將Anthropic的商業成長與擴大公益資源連結，作為公共利益公司，有別於典型科技股權實務。治理、基線估值與實際運用等關鍵細節仍待披露。
items_flat.quote: Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic’s shares will be committed today, with an additional 2% added at the board’s discretion for every 50% increase in the company’s value above a set baseline.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在股東批准下，今天將承諾Anthropic 5%的股份，之後公司價值每較設定基線增加50%，董事會可再酌情增加2%。

items_flat.title_en: Meta publishes technical report on open-weight Muse Glimmer 30B for on-device agentic tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Meta發布開源Muse Glimmer 30B技術報告，專為裝置端代理任務設計
items_flat.summary_en: On October 19 Meta released a technical report on Muse Glimmer, its 30B open-weight model with a perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. The model is quantized to ~4-bit for single-GPU inference and is released under Apache 2.0; Meta states it leads comparably sized open models on tool use and multi-step planning.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta於10月19日發布Muse Glimmer技術報告，這是30B開源模型，配備感知編碼器，專為消費級硬體上的自主代理任務設計。模型量化至約4-bit以支援單GPU推論，採Apache 2.0授權；Meta稱其在工具使用與多步驟規劃上領先同級開源模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: An Apache 2.0 local agent model that fits on a consumer GPU lowers the barrier for private or offline agent workflows. Vendor-reported benchmarks still need independent confirmation of real-world reliability and failure recovery.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 可在消費級GPU上運行的Apache 2.0本地代理模型，降低了私密或離線代理工作流程的門檻。廠商回報的基準仍需獨立驗證真實可靠性與故障恢復能力。
items_flat.quote: Today we published a technical report on Muse Glimmer, our 30B open-weight model built for agentic tasks on consumer hardware. It runs at practical speeds on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU at 4-bit precision.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們發布了Muse Glimmer的技術報告，這是我們為消費級硬體上的代理任務打造的30B開源模型。它在單一消費級GPU以4-bit精度於Mac或PC上以實用速度運行。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI reportedly accelerating ~$30B round at over $1.4T valuation ahead of Anthropic IPO
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI據報加速約300億美元融資，估值或超1.4兆美元，以搶在Anthropic IPO前
items_flat.summary_en: Reuters reported on October 19-20 that OpenAI is racing to secure commitments for a roughly $30 billion financing round that could value the company above $1.4 trillion, ahead of Anthropic’s expected mid-November IPO. SoftBank and MGX are among existing backers in talks to participate; the company has not confirmed the details.
items_flat.summary_zh: Reuters於10月19-20日報導，OpenAI正加速爭取約300億美元融資承諾，估值或超過1.4兆美元，以搶在Anthropic預計11月中IPO之前。SoftBank與MGX等既有投資人據稱正在洽談參與；公司尚未確認細節。
items_flat.analysis_en: The compressed timeline highlights intensifying capital competition between the two leading labs and sensitivity to Anthropic’s upcoming public disclosures. Valuation and final terms remain unconfirmed and could shift with market conditions or Anthropic’s IPO pricing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 壓縮時程凸顯兩大實驗室間資本競爭加劇，以及對Anthropic即將公開資訊的敏感度。估值與最終條款尚未確認，可能因市場狀況或Anthropic IPO定價而變動。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic in talks for second ~$45B Nscale compute deal at West Virginia campus
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic正洽談與Nscale第二筆約450億美元算力合約，位於西維吉尼亞園區
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg and Reuters reported on October 19-20 that Anthropic is in talks with Nvidia-backed Nscale for a second deal worth about $45 billion to secure roughly 460 MW of capacity at its Monarch campus in West Virginia using Vera Rubin chips. Anthropic already has an agreement of similar scale with Nscale; both sides declined comment and terms could change.
items_flat.summary_zh: Bloomberg與Reuters於10月19-20日報導，Anthropic正與Nvidia支持的Nscale洽談第二筆約450億美元合約，以取得西維吉尼亞Monarch園區約460 MW算力，使用Vera Rubin晶片。Anthropic已與Nscale有類似規模協議；雙方拒評，條款仍可能變動。
items_flat.analysis_en: A second large commitment would further lock in multi-year infrastructure ahead of Anthropic’s expected IPO and illustrate the scale of compute required for continued frontier training. The talks remain non-binding and come amid broader scrutiny of debt-funded AI data-center buildouts.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 第二筆大型承諾將在預期IPO前進一步鎖定多年期基礎設施，並顯示持續前沿訓練所需算力規模。洽談仍不具約束力，且正值市場對債務融資AI資料中心建設的更廣泛審視。

items_flat.title_en: Meta details Prometheus gigawatt-scale supercluster used to train Muse Wonder models
items_flat.title_zh: Meta詳述用於訓練Muse Wonder模型的Prometheus千兆瓦級超級叢集
items_flat.summary_en: Meta published an engineering post on October 19 describing Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale supercluster in New Albany, Ohio. The first phase is complete with hundreds of thousands of GPUs and was used to train Muse foundational models including Muse Wonder; Meta reported >85% goodput on pre-training and >90% on RL runs, with plans to scale toward ~1 million GPUs.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta於10月19日發布工程文章，詳述俄亥俄州New Albany的Prometheus千兆瓦級超級叢集。第一階段已完成，配備數十萬GPU，用於訓練包括Muse Wonder在內的Muse基礎模型；Meta稱預訓練goodput超過85%、RL超過90%，並計畫擴展至約100萬GPU。
items_flat.analysis_en: Concrete reliability numbers at this scale illustrate the infrastructure engineering required to train frontier models and give context for Meta’s recent Muse Wonder claims. Full capacity timeline and independent verification of goodput remain open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此規模的具體可靠性數據說明訓練前沿模型所需的基礎設施工程，並為Meta近期Muse Wonder宣稱提供脈絡。全容量時程與goodput的獨立驗證仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Across a supercluster with hundreds of thousands of GPUs, even one underperforming host can slow an entire training run. We engineered Prometheus for resilience at scale, achieving 85%+ goodput on pretraining, 90%+ on reinforcement learning.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在擁有數十萬GPU的超級叢集中，即使一台表現不佳的主機也可能拖慢整個訓練運行。我們為Prometheus設計了規模級韌性，在預訓練達到85%以上goodput，強化式學習達到90%以上。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI highlights stronger model capabilities for low-resource languages like COBOL and Fortran
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI強調模型在COBOL、Fortran等低資源語言的能力提升
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted on October 19 that its latest model advances deliver stronger capabilities for building and migrating software in low-resource programming languages such as COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic. The company released MultiLangBench and a COBOL migration evaluation, reporting large gains (e.g., GPT-6 Astra at 87.4% average on MultiLangBench vs 26.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol).
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於10月19日發文表示，最新模型進展為COBOL、Fortran與Visual Basic等低資源程式語言的軟體建構與遷移帶來更強能力。公司發布MultiLangBench與COBOL遷移評估，並報告顯著提升（例如GPT-6 Astra在MultiLangBench平均達87.4%，較GPT-5.6 Sol的26.8%大幅進步）。
items_flat.analysis_en: Progress on legacy languages addresses a practical enterprise bottleneck where modern models have historically underperformed due to sparse training data. The absence of specific benchmarks on production mainframe systems leaves real-world impact to be verified.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 在遺留語言上的進展解決了現代模型因訓練資料稀缺而長期表現不佳的企業實務瓶頸。缺乏針對生產級大型主機系統的具體基準，真實影響仍待驗證。
items_flat.quote: Our latest model advances bring stronger capabilities for building and migrating software in low-resource programming languages such as COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們最新的模型進展為COBOL、Fortran與Visual Basic等低資源程式語言的軟體建構與遷移帶來更強能力。

items_flat.title_en: MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash with claimed generational leap in agentic and coding tasks
items_flat.title_zh: MiniMax推出M3.1 Flash，宣稱在代理與編碼任務上實現代際躍升
items_flat.summary_en: MiniMax officially rolled out M3.1 Flash on October 19, describing it as a next-generation Flash model that delivers major improvements in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use, and cybersecurity, with nearly 3x faster online inference and 70% lower usage cost. Pricing is $0.15 / $0.60 per million input/output tokens; weights are promised later.
items_flat.summary_zh: MiniMax於10月19日正式推出M3.1 Flash，描述其為新一代Flash模型，在代理任務、編碼、Computer Use與網路安全上大幅提升，線上推論速度近3倍、使用成本降低70%。定價為每百萬輸入/輸出token 0.15/0.60美元；權重稍後公布。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release underscores Chinese labs’ ability to deliver high agentic capability at aggressive price and speed points, potentially pressuring frontier pricing. Independent verification of the claimed benchmark parity and production reliability is still limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發布凸顯中國實驗室以積極價格與速度點提供高代理能力的能力，可能對前沿定價形成壓力。所宣稱基準對等與生產可靠性的獨立驗證仍有限。
items_flat.quote: As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%.
items_flat.quote_zh: 作為新一代Flash模型，M3.1 Flash在代理任務、編碼、Computer Use與網路安全方面實現代際躍升，同時使線上推論速度提升近三倍，並將使用成本降低70%。

brief_en: OpenAI is accelerating a ~$30B round that could value it above $1.4T ahead of Anthropic’s mid-November IPO. Anthropic is in talks for a second ~$45B Nscale compute deal while its Public Benefit Fund structure remains pending approval. Meta detailed Prometheus reliability and published a Muse Glimmer report; MiniMax launched M3.1 Flash. No major new model launches from tracked labs in the last 12 hours.
brief_zh: OpenAI 加速約300億美元融資，估值或超1.4兆美元，以搶在Anthropic 11月中IPO前。Anthropic正洽談第二筆約450億美元Nscale算力合約，公益基金架構仍待股東批准。Meta詳述Prometheus可靠性並發布Muse Glimmer報告；MiniMax推出M3.1 Flash。過去12小時無主要大廠新模型發布。
